scientific_scope: Rh 催化 allenene 到 P1/P2 的催化机制、初始机理竞争、活化控制及两产物竞争。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 局部转化的实际活化自由能、各步前体定义和对应成键/氢迁移证据；不能相加局部势垒冒充整体势垒。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: 局部转化的实际活化自由能、各步前体定义和对应成键/氢迁移证据；不能相加局部势垒冒充整体势垒。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 关键中间体相对能量、对应局部活化量及配位/CO换参照关系。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: 关键中间体相对能量、对应局部活化量及配位/CO换参照关系。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 局部闭环实际活化自由能及前体、成键和cis构型映射的原生证据。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: 局部闭环实际活化自由能及前体、成键和cis构型映射的原生证据。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 相连中间体相对能量、局部活化量与CO/配位参照换算。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: 相连中间体相对能量、局部活化量与CO/配位参照换算。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 通往 P1 的关键相连反应态/中间体相对能量与局部活化量，包含模型内的 CO/配体库存。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed relative energies and local activation requirements along the connected P1 route, with CO/ligand inventory included consistently.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 通往 P2 的关键相连反应态/中间体相对能量与局部活化量，包含模型内的 CO/配体库存。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed relative energies and local activation requirements along the connected P2 route, with CO/ligand inventory included consistently.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 从局部前体及稳定催化态出发的活化量、两分支可比总体活化需求及差值；交代换参照关系。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Local and resting-state-referenced activation energies, comparable overall activation requirements for both product branches and their difference, with reference conversions stated.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 所选初始机制与实质竞争机制的可比活化量及差值，不要求穷尽论文所有方案。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Comparable activation energies and differences for the proposed initial mechanism and substantive alternatives; an exhaustive reproduction of every published alternative is not required.

final_outcomes.description: 从底物到P1的连通形成解释
控制活化需求的转化及参照解释
两产物分支均可竞争的解释
初始转化的竞争性机理判断

verification_support: 正文 Scheme 3/Fig.1、SI S34–35 与能量结构表；历史验证支持 17 个态、6 个 TS 及连接。部分连接使用模式位移/QRC，不全部为完整 IRC。
boundaries: P2 的 cis 身份已公开，不单独计预测分；不扩展到 CO 插入产物和定量产率。
局部势垒、静息态到控制转化的需求须分清，CO 结合/解离须配平。
不规定唯一状态序列、网络节点数或完整 IRC 算法。
source_locator: Main PDF pp2–3 Scheme 3/Figure 1; SI S34–35 Figures S2/S4 and S39–42 structures/Table S2
whole_case_success: All required_for_success outcomes must pass for whole-case success; each supported independent outcome retains its weighted points if other outcomes fail.
